record: simulated, not measured; pre-layout; R9/R10 are not the graded (post-layout) value

method.analysis: .tran 2.5n 600u, waveforms saved from 480u (a 120 us tail); max step 2.5 ns = T/200 at 2 MHz
method.startup: Vin ramps 0 -> Vin over 10 us, control rails/bias over 5 us, EN at 20 us (soft start ~200 us), load applied 0 -> I at 260 us over 0.5 us
method.steady_state: spec 0.4: two consecutive 20-cycle windows < 0.1 % in mean Vout and < 1 % in peak I(L), at the measured cycle period, stepped back from the last whole cycle; the record gives the window and when the chain of passing windows starts
method.settling_window_start: per unit: units[].settled_since_s; measurement window units[].window_s
method.clock: cycle period and phase from rising crossings of Vin/2 on V(sw) over the saved tail (free-running oscillator)

R4.what: mean Vout, C-full x load {0, 50, 250, 500 mA}, untrimmed

R6.what: forced PWM at 0 and 50 mA, C-full: a rising SW edge every period (longest period / median <= 1.5), inductor current negative at 0 load, switching continues to the end of the run
R6.not_observed: the OCP trip net is not saved: 'does not trip' is inferred from uninterrupted switching only

R7.what: switching frequency over >= 100 settled cycles, C-full x all loads

unsettled_clock_observation_hz.note: mean period of V(sw) rising edges over the saved tail of runs that did NOT settle; not a graded value

R8.what: inductor ripple p-p, the three Vin / L combinations of R8 (typical, 27 C, 250 mA)

R9.what: PRE-LAYOUT peak efficiency, C-typ, best of loads {50, 250, 500 mA} (100 mA not run); graded value is post-layout (#27)

R10.what: PRE-LAYOUT efficiency at 500 mA, C-full (report only: no floor is ratified)

R11.what: Vout ripple p-p after 20 MHz 1st-order LP, C-full x load {50, 500 mA}
